results.title: A citation to an evidence node the reader may not see
results.evidence: `GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}` authorises `document:read` with NO model, while `GET /api/v1/documents?urn=` passes one and refuses this reader 'out_of_scope'. So a principal scoped to LE-XX-99 is served an LE-US-01 model's compiled document by id — 15 sections of its identity, methodology, findings and approvals — and told its 1 citation(s) are sound. The soundness claim is itself unscoped
